description: The shape a flow hook returns (`step`, `data`, `error`, `order`, `next`, `back`, `submit`, `retry`). The UI and the tests depend on it, so the implementation behind it can be swapped.
One `step` field with a union of values instead of several booleans, so combinations like "submitting and failed" cannot be represented.
An event that makes no sense in the current state, such as paying from the cart or going back while the order is being placed. It must be ignored, not half-applied.
In the Query version, the visible step computed from the mutation status and the wizard position instead of being stored a second time.
In XState, async work started by entering a state (`invoke` with `fromPromise`) and stopped when the state is left; its result arrives as `onDone`/`onError` of that state.
A ref set synchronously when a request starts. Hook-based versions need it because state from the last render cannot see a call made in the same tick.
